description: React component implementing a Portfolio page for a stock trading platform, including CRUD operations for positions, price updates, sorting, and display of position and portfolio totals.

methods.name: Portfolio
methods.description: React functional component rendering the portfolio management UI.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new position to the portfolio, performing validation and state updates.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing of a selected position.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited position data after validation.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and performs deletion of a position.

methods.name: handlePriceChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the last price input fields.

methods.name: savePrice
methods.description: Validates and saves the updated last price for a position.
